questions.prompt: Is there a defect in how this consumer settles messages from the queue? If so, mark the line(s) where it is; otherwise answer that there is none.
A message whose body is not valid JSON is received. What happens to it?
choices: It is abandoned, and retried until the entity's maximum delivery count is reached
It is dead-lettered immediately with reason `MalformedPayload`, because redelivering the same bytes cannot succeed
It is completed and discarded after a log line
The processor stops, because the JsonException escapes the handler

questions.prompt: The same scan event is delivered twice (at-least-once delivery) and the second copy arrives after the first was fully processed. What is the effect on the database?
choices: A duplicate row is added to scan_events and the shipment is updated twice
The second INSERT throws a unique violation, which the consumer dead-letters
The transaction is rolled back and the message is abandoned until it expires
No new row is written and the shipments update is skipped, since the INSERT reports 0 rows

questions.prompt: With MaxConcurrentCalls = 8, two scans for the same shipment are handled concurrently, and the older scan happens to commit last. What is the shipment's status afterwards?
choices: The status from the newer scan, because the UPDATE only applies when last_scan_at is older than the incoming ScannedAt
The status from whichever message was dequeued last
Undefined, because the two transactions deadlock and one is dropped
The status from the older scan, because it committed last
